Hi there,

Sorry, I know you've been waiting on this one since we moved it to mid-October. Your order Shop····, the Harlo B30 plus the Power K., hasn't shipped yet. That's why you don't have a tracking number.

Your B30 is in batch 1. The US units are arriving at our warehouse now and being scanned in. Some of that shipment has landed and the rest is still on its way. The warehouse ships the oldest orders first, and your order number falls inside this batch. That could still shift a little as stock moves between our warehouses. The Power K. is already set aside for you and goes in the same box.

I've asked a colleague to make sure your unit is assigned to you as the units are checked in. They're on it today. Once your box leaves the warehouse, the tracking number is emailed to you automatically.

You can follow this shipment's progress to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
